programmes.d: As Tora squares off against Hakumen, Tora's memory is restored to the people who've forgotten him.
Mikan finally makes her debut, and Yuko's anxiety spikes to even higher levels! Is the magical girl here to murderize Yuko or for another reason?
Humans and yokai unite behind Ushio to fight Hakumen; Saya opens the gates to the underworld for help; Hyou faces Guren in a fight to the death.
Yuko and Momo finally resume their duel. In the end, there can be only one winner - who will receive the higher exam score? Later, Mikan takes Yuko to a zombie horror movie.
Mayuko tries to revive a wounded Tora.
Look out Yuko, Shion's up to something - and she won't rest until she runs her experiments! Then, can Yuko and Momo keep a secret from Ryoko?
The humans join the fight at sea; Ushio and Tora find themselves at the mercy of Hakumen's most dangerous form.
Yuko's worried about Momo and dives into her dreams again to get the magical girl to open up. However, is that a good idea? Who knows what could happen this time.
Hakumen, driven mad with hatred, hunts down the spear; Ushio and Tora make an impossible choice.
Momo needs to process the shocking revelations that rocked her to the core! Perhaps Yuko can solve the dilemma by offering Momo a deal with a demon girl.
A boy constantly battles his father to see who is the best chef at the family restaurant.
Hiraku won't waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.
Soma goes up against the owner of the "God's Tongue."
As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku's loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.
Soma causes a stir at the opening ceremony by declaring his intentions to be number one.
Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.
Soma arrives at Polar Star Dormitory with high expectations, but finds an unexpected challenge.
Now that they've secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.
Soma faces an unofficial challenge that is very different from an official one.
With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation and just in time; Winter is coming.
Soma is drawn to Donmono Research Society, but discovers that it is being threatened by Erina's lackey.
A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.
The Shokugeki between Mito Ikumi and Yukihira Soma begins and Soma will have to transform his cheap ingredients to defeat the Meat Master's expensive beef.
Hiraku realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.
A brutal training camp is underway and those in Polar Star Dorm are determined to survive; Soma may have met his match.
They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village's case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.
Hiraku's offhand remark leads to a series of events that conclude with a merchant, establishing trade relationships with The Great Tree Village.
Soma is fired up by Takumi Aldini's challenge as he seeks the perfect ingredient to set his dish apart.
Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. “Attempts” being the keyword.
Soma and Megumi are given a complex "recette" that they must follow to the letter.
News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren't the only ones interested in the good news.
Soma's reckless streak lands him and Megumi in hot water as they face not a student, but a magician.
Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.
Megumi has a chance to show off her skills as Soma takes the supporting role.
Kanie's new ticket prices are having a not-so-surprising backlash - the park's broke. Desperate, he, Sento, and a few of the mascots head to a cave rumored to hide treasure.
The training camp lives up to its tough reputation when the students must make breakfast without any sleep.
With the park beginning to prosper, Kanie and Sento begin to interview for more staff, but Sento is a little... on edge about it.
Soma's dish is deflating, and it will take focus to get back on track.
Satsuki warns Misaki about a group of stalkers targeting cosplay cafes, but she isn't worried. On this night, however, the boss is late and Misaki has to close shop alone.
The members of Polar Star Dormitory are treated to a meal from a surprise guest.
Misaki has new fans at school- the Inuyama brothers. They want to know all about her, but this will reveal her secret. Should she tell them the truth and risk her reputation?
Soma has a showdown with his dad with Isshiki, Tadokoro, and Fumio judging.
Misaki breaks up a fight between students from Seika High and Miyabigaoka Academy. When she brings the Seika students to Miyabigaoka to apologize, Takumi tags along.
Soma returns home and must serve his customers at Yukihira.
Misaki's torn over Miyabigaoka's surprise offer. When she finally goes to give her reply, her friends worry Seika High wouldn't be where it is today without her.
Soma and his team work on a portable dish to combat the Mozuya invasion, and look to make their mark on the Sumire shopping district.
Takumi narrates a strange retelling of the legend of Momotaro with Misaki as the titular character herself.
The lists for the Autumn Elections are out; Soma seeks out a former colleague of his father's.
Sakura, an avid fan of rock band Yumemishi, is in love with its vocalist Kuuga. She invites her friends to a party with the band, but Kuuga has his eyes on Misaki instead.
Soma and the others work to enhance their dishes before heading into the prelims.
Usui meets Misaki's mom and helps her, and she invites him home for tea. Misaki drags him from her home. When her friends see them leave together, what else would they think?
The Autumn Election preliminaries are underway as Megumi shocks everyone with a tricky ingredient.
It's the Sports Festival, and the boys have decided that the Grand Prize is a kiss from a horrified Sakura. Misaki competes to save her, despite all efforts to disqualify her.
Hoshino's curry is judged and the Aldini brothers face off; the judges almost forget Megumi.
Aratake, the strongest delinquent in school, can't believe Naoya, a former gang leader, has gone soft; the gang abducts Yukimura, whom they mistake for Naoya's girlfriend.
Group A is reeling as a judge continues to give zero points; Ryo Kurokiba presents a dish that surprises everyone.
The Student Council plans an open house at Seika High to boost female enrollment. However, a girl-hating freshman, Soutarou, goes to extreme measures to derail their efforts.
Soma faces off against Akira Hayama and the finalists are chosen.
Sakura wants to confess her feelings to her crush, Nozaki. Unfortunately, when she does, he thinks she is just a fan of his shojo manga.

Maddie, a bullied teen, receives help from a stranger online; Caspian, a teen loner and math genius, struggles with his parents' toxic relationship; Chanda, a computer engineer, secretly meets with a rival tech giant.
Nozaki's friend and fellow manga artist Mikoshiba pays a visit. Considering Mikoshiba is pretty much Nozaki's foil, Sakura can't figure out how or why the two are friends.
Sakura learns that she and Mikoshiba aren't the only ones helping Nozaki with his mangas. Concerned with who may be cozying up to Nozaki, Sakura is on a new mission.

Ellen fights with Logorhythms over control of David's consciousness; Maddie learns the truth about her father's death and meets a stranger who wants to help; Caspian stumbles on Maddie's crisis on the dark web; a new consciousness is uploaded.
Mikoshiba is invited to a mixer, but isn't sure about his social skills. Fortunately, with a little help from Nozaki and Sakura, he might be able to figure it out just enough.

Chanda's life is on a loop; Maddie and David make up for time lost; Ellen tries to move on from her dead husband; Caspian watches his parents' marriage disintegrate while trying to start a romance of his own.
When Sakura notices that Nozaki's apartment is pristine, she panics, worried that he's trying to impress another girl. What she discovers is even more irritating.
Nozaki gives Wakamatsu a gift to help him fight his insomnia, but what he doesn't tell him is that this gift may also be his worst nightmare.

David learns how to maximize his power from an unlikely source; Maddie and Ellen find out they aren't alone; Cary questions the plan; Caspian gets closer to Hannah and the truth; Chanda seeks revenge.
Nozaki needs inspiration for his artwork so Sakura decides to take him on what she believes is a date, but a few awkward encounters make her reconsider.
Posing manga characters is a never-ending challenge for Nozaki, but two of his models may become a real life couple!
Caspian fights to learn the truth about his identity; an unlikely team builds David a new home in a familiar place; David and Laurie fight to evade those who are trying to delete them.
Sakura and Nozaki find themselves living in a real-life manga, but while Sakura daydreams of romance it's no surprise to find that Nozaki is completely clueless.
The flaw takes its toll on Laurie; Caspian's and Maddie's worlds finally collide; Chanda builds his own reality.
The group has various repeated, awkward attempts at love, and it appears some people are catching on to who they are in Nozaki's manga.
Nozaki is up to his usual social experiments, and this time Sakura isn't the only one being tricked and observed! This time the guys are the focus.
Caspian searches for a new life; the superpowers catch up; Laurie and Chanda consider moves that could change the world forever.
After numerous failed attempts at grabbing Nozaki's attention, it finally seems as though Sakura may have the perfect opportunity.
When challenging an archnemesis to a duel, please make sure they do not mistake it as an invitation to hang out. It's awkward for everyone involved.
America enters the cloud; Caspian takes over; Chanda forms a new rebellion; Cody continues the fight; David enters the battle; Waxman gets off the fence.
Mikan realizes something - she recognizes the box that seals Shamiko's dad. That means the factory ruins on the outskirts of town hold clues about Momo's sister! Maybe.
A boy constantly battles his father to see who is the best chef at the family restaurant.
After hearing that Lilith has been sealed for over 2000 years, Shamiko and Momo come up with a plan to let her borrow Shamiko's body and enjoy a day of freedom.
Shamiko visits a cafe rumored to be frequented by demons in search of clues about Sakura, but somehow ends up getting a part-time job instead!
Soma goes up against the owner of the "God's Tongue."
Shamiko learns that Lico and Shirosawa have a connection to Sakura and decides to continue working part-time at the cafe. However, Momo is vehemently opposed to it!
Soma causes a stir at the opening ceremony by declaring his intentions to be number one.
When Shamiko finds herself in trouble, the one who saves her is none other than Sakura Chiyoda! Meanwhile, Momo takes a certain action to save Shamiko from her nightmare.
